verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a web-based document generator, and Cooley AI is a firm-owned AI company, so a public API with an interactive reference is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no API reference, developer portal or runnable examples. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path (all returned 404), and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
